name: saas-calendar-view
context: Design a calendar and scheduling interface for a SaaS application. The audience is professionals managing appointments, meetings, and events across day, week, and month views. Target platforms: desktop (primary) and mobile. Must support event creation, drag-to-resize, and time zone awareness.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for date headers, time labels, and event titles
Apply color.rules.json for calendar category colors and today highlight
Use layout.rules.json grid for week/day time slots and month grid
Calendar grid must use proper table or grid role with day/time headers
Event creation via click-and-drag must have keyboard alternative
Time slots must be navigable via arrow keys with clear focus

outputCriteria.format: Component composition spec with month/week/day views, event rendering, and creation flow
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens
Event blocks use category-specific color with sufficient contrast for text
Calendar grid uses consistent cell sizing from spacing tokens
View switcher documents all view states
accessibilityRequirements: Calendar grid uses grid role with proper row/columnheader
Events are announced with time and title via screen reader
View navigation (prev/next month) updates live region
Focus management after event creation returns to calendar

examples.description: Calendar event chip rendered within a day cell
examples.output:
Molecule: CalendarEvent
  Layout: flex(direction: row, align: center, gap: var(--space-2xs))
  bg: var(--color-category-blue-subtle)
  border-left: 3px solid var(--color-category-blue)
  radius: var(--radius-sm)
  padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
  cursor: pointer
  role: button
  aria-label: 'Event Title, 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM'
  Children:
    - Atom: Dot(size=6, bg=var(--color-category-blue))
    - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.xs, color=color.text.primary, truncate=true)
  States: default, hover(shadow: var(--shadow-sm)), focus(outline: var(--color-focus-ring)), dragging(opacity: 0.7)
acceptanceCriteria: Uses category color tokens, not raw values
Event has full accessible name with time range
Truncates title gracefully on small cells
